description_for_human: Finn lokalprodusert mat i Norge. Søk blant gårder, markeder, gårdsbutikker og REKO-ringer med kontaktinfo og åpningstider.
description_for_model: Plugin for searching and discovering local food producers in Norway. Provides access to 1904 verified producers including farms, farmers' markets, REKO rings, farm shops, and cooperatives. Use the search endpoint for natural-language queries (Norwegian or English) and the agents endpoint for structured lookups by city, category, or ID.
